Pirates have commandeered the Ship! They will execute the Crew and steal the Shipment unless you intervene.
<kalguurred>{A well-armed merchant vessel demanded half of our shipment of ore!}
<kalguurred>{Our crew had to dump our shipment of ore to outrun a pirate fleet!}
<kalguurred>{A wasting disease destroyed half of our shipment of crops!}
<kalguurred>{The crew became stuck in a calm sea and had to eat our shipment of crops!}
<kalguurred>{Our shipment of Thaumaturgic Dust collapsed into a portal and vanished!}
<kalguurred>{A Karui raiding party waiting outside Kingsmarch demand half of our entire shipment!}
<kalguurred>{Corrupt customs officials demanded half of our entire shipment!}
<kalguurred>{A quarter of our entire shipment was somehow misplaced at port!}
<kalguurred>{The King decided to institute a one-time tax of three-quarters of our entire outgoing shipment!}
<kalguurred>{Trade disruptions at port caused economic shocks. We only received half of what we expected.}
<kalguurred>{Pirates seized half of our profits on the voyage back!}
<kalguurred>{We were out-negotiated at port, and have received a quarter less than we expected.}
<kalguurred>{The ship experienced a tremendous storm at sea, and three-quarters of our returns have been lost.}
<kalguurred>{Unfortunately, a crew member was killed in a tavern brawl.}
<kalguurred>{A storm knocked a crewmember overboard on the voyage out.}
<kalguurred>{One of our crew decided to stay at port and start a new life.}
<kalguurred>{Dangerous weather has caused a delay.}
<kalguurred>{Our ship was seized by a pirate fleet on the way to port. The entire shipment has been lost.}
<kalguurred>{A mysterious green light surrounded the ship on its voyage home. When it passed, everything was gone.}
